original: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated transparent RGBA production 2D game sprite, modular public elevated walkway deck for Os Cabos, Ferrugem Baixa, Sucateia. Primary request: a SHORT WIDE straight EAST-WEST deck module for the main pedestrian route, not another narrow footbridge. Screen-horizontal alignment, ends left and right entirely open for joining identical modules, both ends at exactly the same projected screen y. Desired proportions of actual physical artwork: overall width220 world pixels, total projected depth125 pixels, empty continuous WALKABLE central rectangle about190 pixels long by80 pixels deep; do not make it a long thin bridge. Top walking deck must be wide enough in the painted image itself, NOT a collision width assumption. Front and back low thin rusty pipe guardrails outside the wide clear central floor, no rail across either open end. Visible upper deck made of weathered reclaimed timber planks with two small flat riveted rusty steel grate repairs, no objects obstructing path. Four compact bolt lugs extend outward at left and right edges, symmetric two per side and pair positions aligned. Underdeck two short complete triangular riveted brackets and connecting beam visible below southern edge; contained support sockets for attachment to existing support towers, no embedded tower or stairs, no ground-support feet. Camera: elevated orthographic THREE-QUARTER TOP-DOWN from SOUTH looking NORTH, dominant broad top surfaces, short southern sidewalls, strictly horizontal east-west, no diagonal isometric view, no vanishing point. Style: dense hand-painted weathered textures, compatible with dark old stone and timber/oxidized copper/iron medieval goblin salvage game; actively repaired, maintained and inhabited, patched timber, replaced bolts, restrained dull rust orange, brown wood, muted copper green. Upper-left diffuse DAYLIGHT, no night glow, no reversed light, no polished glossy gold, no heavy black cartoon outlines. Numerical scale comparison: character/door24–28px, desired empty walking depth80px is over3 character widths; neighboring Cabos T arms only36–46px so this deck must appear distinctly broader and shorter. Composition: full isolated single module centered, comfortable transparent margin at least8 percent on all sides, all lugs/rails/brackets complete and inside image. TRUE transparent alpha background including holes. No ambient brown haze, cast shadow, glow, floor slab, surrounding ground, terrain, buildings, water, people, lettering, signs, labels, logos, scenery, crane, chains crossing walking surface, props, cargo or lamps. QA intent: clean side connection points, complete underdeck load path, wide unobstructed center readable at world220x125, reusable consecutive E-W modules; no certification of gameplay collisions.
edit1: Edit target: main_deck_ew_v1.png supplied. Preserve hand-painted rusty timber/steel appearance, camera south looking north elevated orthographic, upper-left diffuse daylight, complete left/right open joining ends with paired lugs, underdeck brackets, true transparency. Critical geometry correction: existing central walking floor is too narrow north-south: about300 native pixels versus total artwork width1570. Expand ONLY the broad empty floor north-south until empty central walkable depth between inner rail edges is approximately570 native pixels for artwork width1570, ratio at least0.36. Keep module east-west horizontal, same overall WIDTH, but make it substantially deeper/squatter. Move front and back railings apart, add matching flat timber planks in the floor between them; increase central unobstructed depth by1.85x, NOT length. Complete short supports below new front edge. Front and rear paired left/right connection holes maintain aligned screen y across corresponding sides. Subject should have overall width220 worldpx and actual empty walking depth80px at same uniform scale: not80px including rail/brackets. End crosspieces flat with no railing across ends. Do not add floor objects or stair/tower. Flat grate repairs remain. Whole revised object centered with min8% transparent margins; transparent holes/no shadows, no surrounding ground, no labels/text/logos/people. Target shape visually broad rectangular platform, not thin long footbridge. This is a geometric revision, do not change lighting/style.
edit2: Edit target supplied main_deck_ew_v2.png. One precise geometry correction, preserve style/light/camera/materials and width of the actual physical object: Increase distance between inner edges of front and rear railings by another40 percent. Existing unobstructed rectangle approximately1300 wide by430 high must become1300 wide by600 high. Add extra flat matching timber planks BETWEEN the railings; move rear rail upward and front rail downwards accordingly. New walking floor screen width/clear-depth ratio about2.17, broad/squat rectangle. Overall physical sprite width should remain1620, new height approximately1000; expand canvas height to accommodate, comfortable transparent margin100px all sides so nothing approaches edge. Entire module isolated true transparent RGBA. Keep open west/east ends with flat end bands, complete symmetric bolt lugs and short underside triangulated support brackets. No cross rail across open ends; no floor objects. Elevated orthographic top-down three-quarter SOUTH toward NORTH, upper-left diffuse daylight. Dull rust iron, old wood, oxidized copper hand-painted repaired salvage medieval goblin game. No polished gold, black cartoon outline, ground, shadows, haze, scenery, people, labels, text. Critical acceptance: at uniform scaling to220px overall width, rectangle between inner rail edges must provide at least75px clear actual painted depth; do not count hardware or bracket toward walking depth. Preserve length, enlarge only deck depth, full contained transparency.
